purpose: Machine source-of-truth for which audio codecs and containers SongCore must decode. Humans edit intent here; the machine derives the FFmpeg source closure from the pinned upstream configure oracle (see docs/architecture/ffmpeg-minimization.md). Never hand-edit derived manifests.

output_contract.note: SongCore decodes only; SRC/DSP live in AudioEngine, never here.

aac.note: M4A (mov demuxer) and raw ADTS (aac demuxer).

opus.note: The native Opus decoder pulls libswresample via FFmpeg's own build graph; SongCore does not use swr for its PCM contract.

matroska.reason: Test closure only: Matroska populates both container (segment) and stream (track) metadata, which the frozen canonical-precedence policy machine-tests.
